context: Tatsuya visits Ryosuke. Both reflect on extended family expanding.
purpose: two adult men reflecting on family generations

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 亮介さん、達也とメイの赤ちゃん、生まれたって、聞いた。
lines.en: Ryosuke-san, I heard Daichi and Mei's baby was born.
lines.style: Warm, straightforward delivery. Gentle opening on the news. Quiet pleasure underneath — the kind of happiness that doesn't need performance. Steady pace, unhurried.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本当に、嬉しいニュース。家族、また、広がりますね。
lines.en: That's truly wonderful news. The family grows bigger.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Brief pause after 'family' — letting the significance settle. Voice carries genuine warmth, almost tender. Philosophical but grounded, not flowery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: わいも、ようやく、お祖父さん代わり、果たせる。
lines.en: And I finally get to be a grandfather.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the words. A small smile audible in the voice. Unhurried pace. The weight of a long-awaited role acknowledged without fanfare — just honest satisfaction.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 達也さん、お父さんになって、本当に、立派。
lines.en: Daichi really has become a fine father.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, warm and steady. Recognition without excess — the respect of someone who sees character and names it plainly. Voice is soft but sure, not flattering.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 皆で、ちゃんと、見守って、応援しような。
lines.en: We'll all watch over them and support them properly.
lines.style: Settled, inclusive tone. Speaking from years of knowing what family means. Quiet firmness — not a directive but a given. Slow, deliberate delivery suggesting commitment.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: もちろん。家族って、いいですね。
lines.en: Of course. Family really is something good.
lines.style: Simple, genuine. A quiet closing note — not wistful, but content. Understated warmth. The tone of someone who has lived long enough to know this is true.
